Strictly Come Dancing visit The Hub on Verulam for filming

8th October
Strictly Come Dancing
Celebrities
Entertainment
TV
St Albans
By Huw Richards Reporter

Share

0 comments

Stars of this year's Strictly Come Dancing series were welcomed to a well-known St Albans restaurant for filming.

The Hub on Verulam will feature on the BBC in this Saturday's episode of Strictly after hosting crews.

A post by The Hub reveals John Nellis and Katya Jones dined at the VESPER Restaurant during a segment for the show.

It read: "Strictly came to The Hub on Verulam

"Here’s a little behind-the-scenes look at the BBC filming our short snippet for Saturday’s episode of Strictly Come Dancing.

"We welcomed @johnnellis and @katyajones for dinner at @vesperstalbans while the cameras rolled, and here’s how it all came together."

Jones and Nellis have started strongly in this year's Strictly series

Nellis is one of the UK’s biggest sports content creators, with more than 20 million followers across social media.

He is partnered with Jones in the 2026 series and the pair have already impressed, topping the leaderboard in the first live show.

The Hub on Verulam is a modern social, cultural, dining and co-working venue at 5 Verulam Road.

It serves breakfast, brunch, lunch, artisan coffee and sweet treats by day, then becomes VESPER, an evening restaurant and bar serving sharing plates, signature martinis and cocktails.
